title: Trump briefed on Nordic aliens

tellings.quote: yeah, wasn't he briefed on like Nordics or something like Nordic aliens?

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, asks on his show whether Donald Trump, the US president, was once briefed about 'Nordics', aliens said to look like tall, fair-haired humans. It is put as a question and not as a claim, and it hints that a president may have been told about specific kinds of beings.
